manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and gravitational force remain fully active.
manifest.description: A side-by-side view showing a tossed ball on a height ruler alongside its velocity-time graph, demonstrating constant downward acceleration throughout the motion.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings near the top.
